description: The Oros reservoir study couples RAMS atmospheric forcing with the SMA component of HEC-HMS to forecast inflows and evaluate seasonal release decisions in semiarid Brazil. This resource is provided by Samuellson Lopes Cabral; José Nilson Bezerra Campos; Cleiton da Silva Silveira. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists JPG, XLS formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The title names ECHAM 4.1 while the abstract says 4.5; that version conflict is unresolved. Forecast skill remains study-specific. For simulation, it documents an application that can inform scenario design. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
